# New tasks for the Jewish court positions (jip_jewish_court_positions.txt). Vanilla tasks they share are in
# jip_vanilla_task_overrides.txt. Generated by make_jewish_court_position_tasks.py.
# root = the holder, scope:liege = the employer

# The Rosh Yeshiva trains a Jewish courtier each year, raising their Learning
jip_rosh_yeshiva_train_disciples = {
	court_position_types = { jip_rosh_yeshiva_court_position }

	cost = {
		round = no
		prestige = {
			add = {
				value = monthly_court_position_task_cost
				desc = COURT_POSITION_TASK_COST_BREAKDOWN_BASE
				format = "BASE_VALUE_FORMAT_DECIMALS_PLUS_NEGATIVE"
			}
		}
	}

	employee_modifier = {
		monthly_learning_lifestyle_xp_gain_mult = 0.1
	}

	scaling_employer_modifiers = {
		terrible = {
			monthly_piety = 0.1
		}
		poor = {
			monthly_piety = 0.2
		}
		average = {
			monthly_piety = 0.3
		}
		good = {
			monthly_piety = 0.4
		}
		excellent = {
			monthly_piety = 0.5
		}
	}

	is_shown = {
	}
	is_valid_showing_failures_only = {
	}

	on_start = {
		custom_tooltip = jip_rosh_yeshiva_train_disciples_tt
	}
	on_end = {
	}
	on_yearly = {
		random = {
			chance = {
				value = "aptitude(jip_rosh_yeshiva_court_position)"
				multiply = 15
				add = 20
			}
			scope:liege = {
				random_courtier = {
					limit = {
						is_adult = yes
						has_religion = religion:judaism_religion
						NOT = { this = root }
						learning < 20
					}
					save_scope_as = jip_disciple
				}
			}
			scope:jip_disciple ?= {
				scope:liege = {
					send_interface_toast = {
						type = event_toast_effect_good
						title = jip_rosh_yeshiva_train_disciples_toast
						left_icon = scope:jip_disciple
						scope:jip_disciple = { add_learning_skill = 1 }
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		value = 25
		scope:liege = {
			if = {
				limit = { ai_zeal >= 0 }
				add = 25
			}
		}
	}
}

# The Av Beit Din judges the community's disputes in the family's name
jip_av_beit_din_judge_community = {
	court_position_types = { jip_av_beit_din_court_position }

	cost = {
		round = no
		gold = {
			value = 0
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:liege = { has_treasury = no }
				}
				add = {
					value = monthly_court_position_task_cost
					desc = COURT_POSITION_TASK_COST_BREAKDOWN_BASE
					format = "BASE_VALUE_FORMAT_DECIMALS_PLUS_NEGATIVE"
				}
			}
		}
		treasury = {
			value = 0
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:liege = { has_treasury = yes }
				}
				add = {
					value = monthly_court_position_task_cost
					desc = COURT_POSITION_TASK_COST_BREAKDOWN_BASE
					format = "BASE_VALUE_FORMAT_DECIMALS_PLUS_NEGATIVE"
				}
			}
		}
	}

	employee_modifier = {
		monthly_learning_lifestyle_xp_gain_mult = 0.1
	}

	scaling_employer_modifiers = {
		terrible = {
			monthly_legitimacy_add = 0.1
			dynasty_opinion = 2
		}
		poor = {
			monthly_legitimacy_add = 0.2
			dynasty_opinion = 4
		}
		average = {
			monthly_legitimacy_add = 0.3
			dynasty_opinion = 6
		}
		good = {
			monthly_legitimacy_add = 0.45
			dynasty_opinion = 8
		}
		excellent = {
			monthly_legitimacy_add = 0.6
			dynasty_opinion = 10
		}
	}

	is_shown = {
	}
	is_valid_showing_failures_only = {
	}

	on_start = {
	}
	on_end = {
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		value = 50
	}
}

# Pidyon shvuyim: the Gabbai Tzedakah buys the freedom of Jews held captive by other rulers. Costs twice the usual task
# gold, which pays the ransoms.
jip_gabbai_tzedakah_ransom_captives = {
	court_position_types = { jip_gabbai_tzedakah_court_position }

	cost = {
		round = no
		gold = {
			value = 0
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:liege = { has_treasury = no }
				}
				add = {
					value = monthly_court_position_task_cost
					multiply = 2
					desc = COURT_POSITION_TASK_COST_BREAKDOWN_BASE
					format = "BASE_VALUE_FORMAT_DECIMALS_PLUS_NEGATIVE"
				}
			}
		}
		treasury = {
			value = 0
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:liege = { has_treasury = yes }
				}
				add = {
					value = monthly_court_position_task_cost
					multiply = 2
					desc = COURT_POSITION_TASK_COST_BREAKDOWN_BASE
					format = "BASE_VALUE_FORMAT_DECIMALS_PLUS_NEGATIVE"
				}
			}
		}
	}

	scaling_employer_modifiers = {
		terrible = {
			monthly_piety = 0.1
		}
		poor = {
			monthly_piety = 0.2
		}
		average = {
			monthly_piety = 0.3
		}
		good = {
			monthly_piety = 0.4
		}
		excellent = {
			monthly_piety = 0.5
		}
	}

	is_shown = {
	}
	is_valid_showing_failures_only = {
	}

	on_start = {
		custom_tooltip = jip_gabbai_tzedakah_ransom_captives_tt
	}
	on_end = {
	}
	on_yearly = {
		random = {
			chance = {
				value = "aptitude(jip_gabbai_tzedakah_court_position)"
				multiply = 15
				add = 25
			}
			random_ruler = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { this = scope:liege }
					is_ai = yes # Never frees the player's prisoners behind their back
					NOT = { has_religion = religion:judaism_religion }
					any_prisoner = { jip_ransomable_captive_trigger = yes }
				}
				random_prisoner = {
					limit = { jip_ransomable_captive_trigger = yes }
					save_scope_as = jip_ransomed_captive
				}
			}
			scope:jip_ransomed_captive ?= {
				scope:liege = {
					send_interface_toast = {
						type = event_toast_effect_good
						title = jip_gabbai_tzedakah_ransom_captives_toast
						left_icon = scope:jip_ransomed_captive
						scope:jip_ransomed_captive = {
							release_from_prison = yes
							add_opinion = {
								target = scope:liege
								modifier = grateful_opinion
								opinion = 30
							}
						}
						add_piety = medium_piety_gain
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		value = 0
		scope:liege = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					ai_compassion >= 0
					gold >= 100
				}
				add = 40
			}
		}
	}
}

# The Shaliach strengthens the ties between the family and the other Jewish communities and rulers
jip_shaliach_bind_communities = {
	court_position_types = { jip_shaliach_court_position }

	cost = {
		round = no
		gold = {
			value = 0
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:liege = { has_treasury = no }
				}
				add = {
					value = monthly_court_position_task_cost
					desc = COURT_POSITION_TASK_COST_BREAKDOWN_BASE
					format = "BASE_VALUE_FORMAT_DECIMALS_PLUS_NEGATIVE"
				}
			}
		}
		treasury = {
			value = 0
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:liege = { has_treasury = yes }
				}
				add = {
					value = monthly_court_position_task_cost
					desc = COURT_POSITION_TASK_COST_BREAKDOWN_BASE
					format = "BASE_VALUE_FORMAT_DECIMALS_PLUS_NEGATIVE"
				}
			}
		}
	}

	employee_modifier = {
		monthly_diplomacy_lifestyle_xp_gain_mult = 0.1
	}

	scaling_employer_modifiers = {
		terrible = {
			judaism_religion_opinion = 3
			monthly_prestige_gain_mult = 0.02
		}
		poor = {
			judaism_religion_opinion = 6
			monthly_prestige_gain_mult = 0.04
		}
		average = {
			judaism_religion_opinion = 9
			monthly_prestige_gain_mult = 0.06
		}
		good = {
			judaism_religion_opinion = 12
			monthly_prestige_gain_mult = 0.08
		}
		excellent = {
			judaism_religion_opinion = 15
			monthly_prestige_gain_mult = 0.1
		}
	}

	is_shown = {
	}
	is_valid_showing_failures_only = {
	}

	on_start = {
	}
	on_end = {
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		value = 40
	}
}

# The Sofer keeps the estate's accounts and contracts: the Mishpacha counterpart of the Seneschal's Handle the
# Estate, without its influence. Estates come with Roads to Power.
jip_sofer_keep_estate = {
	court_position_types = { jip_sofer_court_position }

	cost = {
		round = no
		gold = {
			value = 0
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:liege = { has_treasury = no }
				}
				add = {
					value = monthly_court_position_task_cost
					desc = COURT_POSITION_TASK_COST_BREAKDOWN_BASE
					format = "BASE_VALUE_FORMAT_DECIMALS_PLUS_NEGATIVE"
				}
			}
		}
		treasury = {
			value = 0
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:liege = { has_treasury = yes }
				}
				add = {
					value = monthly_court_position_task_cost
					desc = COURT_POSITION_TASK_COST_BREAKDOWN_BASE
					format = "BASE_VALUE_FORMAT_DECIMALS_PLUS_NEGATIVE"
				}
			}
		}
	}

	employee_modifier = {
		stress_gain_mult = 0.1
	}

	scaling_employer_modifiers = {
		terrible = {
			domicile_build_speed = -0.05
			domicile_build_gold_cost = -0.02
		}
		poor = {
			domicile_build_speed = -0.07
			domicile_build_gold_cost = -0.04
		}
		average = {
			domicile_build_speed = -0.1
			domicile_build_gold_cost = -0.06
		}
		good = {
			domicile_build_speed = -0.15
			domicile_build_gold_cost = -0.08
		}
		excellent = {
			domicile_build_speed = -0.2
			domicile_build_gold_cost = -0.1
		}
	}

	is_shown = {
		has_ep3_dlc_trigger = yes
		has_domicile = yes
	}
	is_valid_showing_failures_only = {
	}

	on_start = {
	}
	on_end = {
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		value = 50
	}
}

# The Parnas collects the community's dues for the family's estate. Estates come with Roads to Power.

		}

	scaling_employer_modifiers = {
		terrible = {
			domicile_monthly_gold_add = 0.1
		}
		poor = {
			domicile_monthly_gold_add = 0.2
		}

		good = {

		}

		}

}

# The Parnas speaks for the community before the liege, earning their goodwill and making an AI liege less likely to
# expel the Jews (jip_expel_the_jews_ai_modifier). Marked with a variable, like vanilla's Organize Court.
jip_parnas_petition_authorities = {
	court_position_types = { jip_parnas_court_position }

	cost = {
		round = no
		gold = {
			value = 0
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:liege = { has_treasury = no }
				}
				add = {
					value = monthly_court_position_task_cost
					desc = COURT_POSITION_TASK_COST_BREAKDOWN_BASE
					format = "BASE_VALUE_FORMAT_DECIMALS_PLUS_NEGATIVE"
				}
			}
		}
		treasury = {
			value = 0
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:liege = { has_treasury = yes }
				}
				add = {
					value = monthly_court_position_task_cost
					desc = COURT_POSITION_TASK_COST_BREAKDOWN_BASE
					format = "BASE_VALUE_FORMAT_DECIMALS_PLUS_NEGATIVE"
				}
			}
		}
	}

	scaling_employer_modifiers = {
		terrible = {
			liege_opinion = 2
		}
		poor = {
			liege_opinion = 4
		}
		average = {
			liege_opinion = 6
		}
		good = {
			liege_opinion = 8
		}
		excellent = {
			liege_opinion = 10
		}
	}

	is_shown = {
		is_independent_ruler = no
	}
	is_valid_showing_failures_only = {
	}

	on_start = {
		custom_tooltip = jip_parnas_petition_authorities_tt
		set_variable = jip_parnas_petitioning
	}
	on_end = {
		remove_variable = jip_parnas_petitioning
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		value = 25
		scope:liege = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					liege ?= { jip_jewish_hostility_value > 0 }
				}
				add = 50
			}
		}
	}
}
